selection: From each original index interval [2,65), [65,129), [129,193), choose most available bright+recovery paired angular-median hypotheses; tie earliest. Evaluation is +2 frames. Already inspected development record, not independent validation.
initialization: Only paired point_map candidates in training views; XY single-link .75 m, largest cluster (tie smallest label). Preserve every candidate/cluster. Ground normal and world plane distance use median causal DVL plane means at training times. PCA XY rectangle encloses candidate cluster; each side at least .2m; median conditional height above ground. No scene, truth, RGB or assessment arrays.
queries: Each view: 8 equally spaced range indices over initial prism vertex slant range span +/- .6m and 4 beam indices over vertex azimuth span +/- 8deg, clipped to native grid. Union with ranges [80,140,200,300] x beams [32,96,160,224]. Freeze before fitting. Evaluation query support is projected from same training seed.
families: shared plane plus one finite opaque ground-supported rectangular prism: 10 parameters including common object/ground log-reflectivity ratio
score: Sum exponential marginal negative log mean score, profiling one positive common brightness gain per view. Pixel correlations are retained in final moments; the marginal fit is composite, never an independent-pixel confidence claim. No score covariance inversion.
search: Deterministic bounded coordinate pattern search, positive/negative each coordinate in fixed order. Retain strictly improved candidate. Ground-only: 2 sweeps at scales [1,.5], steps [0.01,0.01,.05]. Prism joint: 2 sweeps at scales [1,.5], steps [.01,.01,.05,.10,.10,.10,.10,.05,.15,.5]. Recompute first hits and range-derived source normals for every candidate. Retain full trace.
bounds: Ground slope deviations +/- .06, height deviation +/- .3m; prism XY center +/- .6m from seed; side lengths .1 to1.5m; height .05 to1m; yaw +/- pi; log material ratio +/- log(20). Search bounds are computational choices, not calibrated uncertainty.
final_evidence: Every selected raw power, final exact full correlated covariance, full geometry vertices/triangles, initial/final candidate clouds, every fit step and unavailable case. Scene/truth/RGB allowed only after sealed result for assessment/overview. Never trim emitted geometry to pass.
scope: Conditional fixed navigation/DVL means; single-prism shape prior; no inferred pose/plane covariance or native update. A better image score cannot accept a map. Ground support outside measured footprint and extra objects may be wrong.
resource: Existing raw records only; no renderer/SDK mutation, native trial, noise/admission changes, artifacts or cleanup. Bounded arrays at actual 256x256 rays, 599x256 pixels, 15m.
